decisions.reason: Adding links to the footer does not alter the active requirement for no header navigation; that header decision is already represented independently.
The footer link strategy does not change the requirement to use a common header and footer and maintain the dark visual treatment across website pages.
The decision to add footer links over time does not change the implementation stack, handoff objective, or handoff scope.
The footer link strategy is unrelated to the Actia branding requirement for the sign-in page.
The source concerns the public website footer, not the separately scoped console shell footer or its visual styling.
Adding page links to the footer does not modify the landing page's recorded visual theme, typography, colors, hero treatment, or approved design portion.
The source establishes footer link placement over time but does not change responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The footer link strategy does not change any design-token category, font asset, color documentation, content width, or derived design value.
The public website footer decision does not affect the independently scoped provisioning wizard styling or orientation requirements.
